notes.title: Smooth transitions and camera movement option
notes.content:
Thanks so much to everyone that has viewed the film so far! 

A few people were reporting slight motion sickness in the film. My goal is to let you focus on the story as much as possible without distractions. 

So we just pushed out a hotfix that adds the option of camera movement, or no camera movement before you begin the film. 

Additionally you'll notice smoother transitions throughout the film.

Hopefully this will make the story more enjoyable. 
Let me know if you have any other suggestions!
